description: This file defines the EmailService class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing email configuration, sending emails, queueing notifications, and handling email templates and delivery via SMTP or sendmail.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: A service class providing email configuration management, sending, queueing, and template handling functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmailDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailQueueService
methods.description: Retrieves the EmailQueueService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the sendmail program.

methods.name: setSendmailPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the sendmail program.

methods.name: isConfigSet
methods.description: Checks if the email configuration is properly set.

methods.name: setConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether email configuration has been set.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Returns the current email configuration.

methods.name: setMessageSubject
methods.description: Sets the email message subject.

methods.name: setMessageFrom
methods.description: Sets the email sender address.

methods.name: setMessageTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient addresses for the email.

methods.name: setMessageBody
methods.description: Sets the email message body.

methods.name: setMessageCc
methods.description: Sets CC addresses for the email.

methods.name: setMessageBcc
methods.description: Sets BCC addresses for the email.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads email configuration from the database and system settings, initializing transport configurations.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Sets the email configuration object.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService object.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the Mailer instance configured with the current transport.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Assembles and returns the MailTransport object based on current configuration.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MailMessage object with the set properties.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email using the configured Mailer and defined message, returns success status.

methods.name: sendTestEmail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify SMTP or sendmail configuration.

methods.name: validateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates an email address.

methods.name: areRecipientAddressesValid
methods.description: Validates multiple recipient email addresses.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Logs the result of email sending attempts.

methods.name: queueEmailNotifications
methods.description: Queues email notifications for a set of roles related to an event.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateBestMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the best matching email template based on language and roles.

methods.name: queueEmailNotification
methods.description: Queues an individual email notification based on template matching and recipient roles.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of a template file.
